Welcome to my cyberspace! I am Percy Agogo-Mawuli, a scientist and researcher in bioinformatics and clinical data science with expertise in pharmacology, clinical genetics and neuroscience. 
Trained first in pharmacy and then in biomedical science, I now study how genetic variations shape disease and treatment response. My ultimate goal is to close the gap between those findings and the patients who need them.
On a daily basis, I work in Python, R, SQL and Bash, with multiple modalities of biological, chemical and clinical data on HPC and cloud (GCP) systems.
